subject: prd/implementation-verification
statement: When an invocation completes — at whatever rung it stopped — the harness shall emit one structured verdict (closed schema) that enumerates every configured rung's result (pass, fail, skip with reason, `skip:not-reached`, or error), states the overall verdict per §4.3's five states, and records the identity of what it evaluated: workspace revision, diff base, manifest content hash, baseline content hash, and harness version.
rationale: the verdict is the trust artifact reviewers and future consumers read — and a verdict that does not name what it certifies can be true about the wrong tree (AP-13; incident I2)
fit_criterion: every fixture run's verdict — including first-rung-failure runs — validates against the schema and enumerates all configured rungs; no execution path emits a verdict omitting a rung; the revision-mismatch fixture (verdict from commit A presented against commit B) is detected by the recorded identity
